findings.passage: This is why I have pushed for giving all Hoosiers the option for no-excuse absentee voting.
findings.note: Op-ed by Sen. Niezgodski posted on the caucus site. He says he has pushed for no-excuse absentee voting and calls absentee voting easy and secure. It does not mention photo ID or proof of citizenship.
